title.en: National Investment & Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) vs Special Economic Zones (SEZ)
title.hi: National Investment & Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) vs Special Economic Zones (SEZ)

rows.en: Focus on manufacturing growth and employment generation
rows.hi: Focus on manufacturing growth and employment generation

rows.en: Focus on export promotion and foreign exchange earnings
rows.hi: Focus on export promotion and foreign exchange earnings

rows.en: Both provide world-class infrastructure and single-window clearance mechanisms.
rows.hi: Both provide world-class infrastructure and single-window clearance mechanisms.

rows.en: Both aim to attract domestic and foreign investment to boost industrial output.
rows.hi: Both aim to attract domestic and foreign investment to boost industrial output.

clarification.en: NIMZ is designed for large-scale manufacturing for both domestic and export markets, whereas SEZs are primarily focused on export-led growth.
clarification.hi: NIMZ is designed for large-scale manufacturing for both domestic and export markets, whereas SEZs are primarily focused on export-led growth.

relationship.en: NIMZ is the primary implementation vehicle for the National Manufacturing Policy.
relationship.hi: NIMZ is the primary implementation vehicle for the National Manufacturing Policy.
